We are seeking a qualified capital/finance professional to lead the capital and control workstream for new regulated insurance entities established by the Group — including DFSA, Cayman and Lloyd’s structures.   • Manage collateral arrangements for reinsurance programmes (letters of credit, trust accounts, cash deposits) ensuring proper sizing and documentation.
  • Own capital waterfall and inter‑entity funding mechanics – dividend upstream, shareholder loan repayment, capital repatriation within approved limits.
